subject: pathology
title: Alpha-1 Globules, Primary Biliary and Sclerosing Cholangitis, and Hepatic Adenoma

steps.tx: Alpha-1 antitrypsin Z protein polymerises inside hepatocyte endoplasmic reticulum as PAS positive diastase resistant globules, injuring liver by retention while lungs suffer from circulating deficiency. The globules hug periportal hepatocytes and resist diastase digestion that would dissolve glycogen, while the unprotected lung develops early basal panacinar emphysema; a **PiZZ** adult who never smoked yet wheezes at forty deserves both liver staging and spirometry.
steps.say: PAS positive globules that resist diastase are trapped alpha-1 protein injuring the liver that made it.

vis.caption: Electrophoresis patterns where alpha-1 deficiency first betrays itself.

steps.tx: Primary biliary cholangitis autoimmune destroys small intrahepatic ducts in middle aged women with antimitochondrial antibodies, itching, fatigue, and cholestatic enzymes progressing toward biliary cirrhosis. Antimitochondrial antibody appears in over ninety percent of cases, and the biopsy signature called a **florid duct lesion** shows a granuloma strangling a small interlobular duct; pruritus often precedes jaundice by years and worsens characteristically toward evening.
steps.say: Itching, cholestasis, and antimitochondrial antibodies in a middle aged woman mean primary biliary cholangitis.

vis.caption: Primary biliary cholangitis with small duct loss and cholestatic progression.

steps.tx: Ursodeoxycholic acid improves transplant free survival in PBC when alkaline phosphatase responds, second line obeticholic acid and fibrates serving incomplete responders by biochemical criteria. Treatment runs at 13 to 15 mg per kilogram daily, and failure to bring alkaline phosphatase below about 1.67 times the upper limit after a year of **ursodeoxycholic acid** defines the incomplete responder who needs a second agent added promptly.
steps.say: Judge UDCA by alkaline phosphatase response at a year; incomplete responders earn second line therapy.

steps.tx: Primary sclerosing cholangitis scars intra and extrahepatic ducts into beaded strictures, strongly married to ulcerative colitis, risking cholangiocarcinoma and colorectal cancer surveillance duties. Concentric onion skin fibrosis strangles medium ducts on biopsy, about eighty percent of northern European patients carry inflammatory bowel disease, and the colitis of **primary sclerosing cholangitis** often runs quietly right sided while cancer surveillance colonoscopy stays annual from diagnosis.
steps.say: Beaded ducts plus ulcerative colitis equal primary sclerosing cholangitis; cancers shadow both organs.

vis.caption: Primary sclerosing cholangitis with beaded bile duct strictures.

steps.tx: Dominant PSC strictures dilate endoscopically while new strictures earn brushings and imaging against cholangiocarcinoma, whose early detection remains PSC care's hardest problem. Brush cytology misses many early cancers, so fluorescence in situ hybridisation for polysomy and a CA 19-9 climbing above 130 units per millilitre sharpen suspicion; any **dominant stricture** appearing suddenly after stable years gets sampled at ERCP rather than simply dilated.
steps.say: A new dominant stricture in PSC is cholangiocarcinoma until brushings, imaging, and time acquit it.

steps.tx: Hepatic adenoma, benign hepatocyte neoplasm of young women on oestrogen, bleeds or rarely transforms by subtype, HNF1 alpha and beta catenin patterns guiding resection thresholds. Lesions persisting above 5 cm six months after stopping oestrogen usually come out, and any adenoma in a man earns resection regardless of size; the **beta-catenin** activated subtype carries the real transformation threat toward hepatocellular carcinoma and never earns watchful waiting.
steps.say: Stop oestrogen, subtype the adenoma, resect by size sex and beta catenin; hepatic adenomas obey rules.

steps.tx: Adenoma rupture haemorrhages into liver or peritoneum in pregnancy and large subcapsular lesions, embolisation stabilising before staged resection decisions. Transarterial embolisation controls the bleeding vessel in most unstable patients, converting an emergency laparotomy into a planned elective resection weeks later; pregnancy accelerates growth through oestrogen exposure, so a known large **hepatic adenoma** shapes contraception and antenatal imaging plans early.
steps.say: A young woman collapsing with liver haemorrhage may be bleeding from an adenoma; embolise first.

steps.tx: Cholestatic pattern synthesis closes the lesson: duct size, antibodies, bowel associations, drug history, and imaging separate PBC, PSC, IgG4 disease, obstruction, and DILI before biopsy. Ultrasound comes first because dilated ducts redirect everything toward stones or tumour, while nondilated ducts open the medical pathway of antimitochondrial antibody, immunoglobulins and MRCP; **IgG4** related disease slips into that pathway wearing a PSC disguise yet melts under steroids.
steps.say: Small duct, large duct, drug, or stone: cholestasis sorts by duct geography before biopsy speaks.
